definitions.explanation: Worthy of admiration for achievements or status.
Having high social or professional status.
Used to emphasize how bad or difficult something is.

notes:
{偉|えら}い is an i-adjective with multiple meanings depending on context.

FORMS:
- Adverb: {偉|えら}く (very, awfully - colloquial)
- Noun form: {偉|えら}さ (greatness)

MEANING 1 - ADMIRABLE:
- {偉|えら}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a great/admirable person
- {偉|えら}い⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧！: Good job! Well done! (praise)

MEANING 2 - HIGH-RANKING:
- {偉|えら}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: an important/high-ranking person
- お{偉|えら}いさん: bigwig, VIP (slightly sarcastic)

MEANING 3 - COLLOQUIAL INTENSIFIER:
- {偉|えら}く⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧: I'm really tired
- {偉|えら}い⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}った→遭う：09500_au⟧: I had a terrible experience

USAGE — WHO YOU CAN PRAISE:
- Praise with {偉|えら}い⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ points downward — to children, students, or juniors. Said to a boss or a ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧ it sounds condescending; use ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧ or ⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧ there.
- Calling yourself {偉|えら}い sounds boastful. The derived ⟦{偉|えら}そう→偉そう：30176_erasou⟧ ("acting important, stuck-up") is always critical.

SIMILAR ADJECTIVES:
- ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧: splendid, admirable in conduct or appearance; more formal, not about rank
- ⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧: amazing, impressive; casual, about impact rather than worth
- ⟦{偉大|いだい}→偉大：01798_idai⟧: great in a historic sense, used of major figures and achievements

REGIONAL USE:
- In ⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧ and Tōkai speech, {偉|えら}い also means "exhausting, rough," covering ground that standard Japanese gives to ⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧ or ⟦つらい→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧. Learners meet this mainly as ⟦{方言|ほうげん}→方言：07419_hougen⟧.
